story.title: From your drawings to the fitted part.
story.intro: How one part takes shape: a square-to-round transition, from drawing to network.
story.caption: Illustration of the principle — indicative proportions

steps.p: It starts with your drawings: sections, lengths and connections for every part of the network.
The part is laid flat: its pattern gives the exact shape to cut from the sheet.
Folded and seamed, the sheet takes its volume back: here, a square-to-round transition.
Ducts, elbows, fittings and flanges assemble into an air distribution network.

sections.p: Through the quote form only: name, company, email, phone (optional), delivery country and description of requirements. Drawings, if any, are sent by email. No data is collected for advertising.
To review your request, prepare a quote and contact you about it.
Requests are forwarded by email and are accessible only to the Libalstal staff who prepare quotes.

The site sets no tracking cookies. Your theme preference (light/dark) may be remembered in your browser. If Cloudflare Turnstile anti-bot protection is enabled, it may process technical connection data.
You can request access to, correction or deletion of your data by writing to {email}.
The LIBALSTAL logo, texts and visuals on this site belong to their respective owners. Reproduction without permission is prohibited.
The 3D renders and animations on this site are illustrations and do not depict a specific project.

standards.title: Reference standards
standards.intro: Libalstal relies on these references for the design and fabrication of duct systems. They are reference standards, not certifications.

smacna.d: Sheet Metal and Air Conditioning Contractors' National Association (USA): construction standards for metal ducts — thicknesses, reinforcement, joints and sealing.

ashrae.d: American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers: design references and guides for HVAC installations, including duct sizing.

dw144.d: BESA (UK) specification for sheet metal ductwork: construction, air-tightness classes and testing.
